goal: Googlebook OS: run ash-chrome (Chromium linux-chromeos build) as the primary desktop session on Bazzite. DONE: ash renders the real ChromeOS desktop with shelf and wallpaper; Exo hosts external Wayland clients; host .desktop apps publish into the Ash launcher; Exo windows dock on the shelf; end-to-end launch from the launcher works. IN PROGRESS: real per-app icons. TODO: X11 WM_CLASS mapping for Steam/pre-XWayland apps; org.freedesktop.Notifications to message_center bridge; DRM/ozone hardware test on hybrid AMD iGPU + RTX 4060; packaging ash into the OCI image; Waydroid integration.
